notes.deenhindi-nasai:2692: Both complete originals read. Aisha supplies the actual perfuming before entering ihram and on the tenth of Dhul-Hijjah before House tawaf, with musk mixed into the perfume. Preserve the explicit date, both before-relations and the mixture description exactly.
notes.deenhindi-nasai:2701: Both complete originals read. Aisha supplies her habitual best-available perfuming and her actual observation of the perfume's shine in the head and beard before ihram. The source says before, so retain that timing and do not change it to during ihram from outside knowledge. Keep both availability scope and the observation.
